en.headline: World Class University Presidents Forum opens at HKUST
en.dek: Acting Chief Executive Chan Kwok-ki officiates at the two-day event bringing together leaders from about 50 top universities to discuss higher education innovation.
body: The World Class University Presidents Forum 2026 opened on Wednesday at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, drawing presidents and senior leaders from around 50 world-leading universities.

Themed “Higher Education Reimagined: Innovating for the Future”, the two-day forum is supported by the government and hosted by HKUST. Acting Chief Executive Chan Kwok-ki officiated and noted that higher education remains a vital pillar of Hong Kong’s success as a hub for global talent and academic exchange. He highlighted that Hong Kong is the only city with five universities in the global top 100.

Several cooperation agreements were signed during the event, including a memorandum between Zhejiang University and HKUST on a joint innovation centre, and a trilateral seed fund among the University of Warwick, Nanyang Technological University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Discussions cover topics such as educating for the intelligent age and universities driving the future economy.

zh.headline: 世界頂尖大學校長論壇在科大開幕
zh.dek: 署理行政長官陳國基主禮為期兩日的論壇，匯聚約50所頂尖大學領導，共商高等教育創新發展。
body: 世界頂尖大學校長論壇2026周三在香港科技大學開幕，吸引全球約50所頂尖大學的校長和高級管理人員出席。
論壇以「重塑高等教育：創新引領未來」為主題，由特區政府支持、科大舉辦。署理行政長官陳國基主禮並致辭，指高等教育一直是香港成功的重要支柱，也是匯聚全球人才與學術交流的樞紐。他強調香港是全球唯一擁有五所大學位列全球百強的城市。
活動期間簽署多項合作協議，包括浙江大學與科大成立聯合創新中心的備忘錄，以及華威大學、南洋理工大學與上海交通大學的三方聯合種子基金。討論議題包括智能時代人才培養及大學驅動未來經濟等。
